top_repos.portability_reason: The reusable q_lib headers are separable from q_io audio-device, stream, and file code, but templates and memory behavior still need Cortex-M7 profiling.
top_repos.value_reason: Q's q_lib contributes reusable biquads, delay lines, envelopes, oscillators, and pitch utilities without requiring its q_io device layer.
top_repos.port_idea: Start with q_lib biquad, delay, envelope, and oscillator headers; replace q_io with fixed board callbacks and benchmark template size plus denormal behavior.
top_repos.note: Re-entry: updated - Q's q_lib contributes reusable biquads, delay lines, envelopes, oscillators, and pitch utilities without requiring its q_io device layer.
top_repos.summary: C++ Library for Audio Digital Signal Processing

top_repos.portability_reason: Python, PyTorch and FLAMO run only during offline training/export; the deployment artifact is a fixed Faust kernel whose delays, matrices, filters and stability verdict are explicit before firmware compilation.
top_repos.value_reason: ADAC converts trained FLAMO delay, gain, filter and matrix graphs into Faust, emits integer or fractional-delay FDNs, and computes a small-gain stability certificate over the exact single-precision parameters.
top_repos.port_idea: Train and certify a four- or eight-line FDN offline, export only the generated Faust kernel, compile it for Daisy or Teensy, and cap delay maxima to the measured internal or external memory budget.
top_repos.note: Returning - ADAC converts trained FLAMO delay, gain, filter and matrix graphs into Faust, emits integer or fractional-delay FDNs, and computes a small-gain stability certificate over the exact single-precision parameters.
top_repos.summary: Automatic Differentiable Audio Compilation: differentiable audio graphs to real-time DSP

top_repos.portability_reason: The core supports no_std and static dispatch, but it still requires alloc and many delay, reverb, granular and spectral modules own dynamic buffers that must become bounded firmware storage.
top_repos.value_reason: The MIT no_std Rust library combines static DSP chains with predictive ZDF ladder and TPT filters, low-memory delay/reverb variants, tape delay, formant speech, and Karplus-Strong/brass models.
top_repos.port_idea: Build no_std with one static chain, choose the low-memory delay or reverb plus one predictive ZDF or physical-model voice, replace alloc-owned buffers with a fixed arena, and omit OLA, granular, and spectral modules.
top_repos.note: Returning - The MIT no_std Rust library combines static DSP chains with predictive ZDF ladder and TPT filters, low-memory delay/reverb variants, tape delay, formant speech, and Karplus-Strong/brass models.

top_repos.portability_reason: The JUCE-free headers expose bounded processing blocks and fixed AudioBuffer storage, but selected delays and strings allocate vectors at construction and the full repository includes desktop-only Lua, analysis and host layers.
top_repos.value_reason: The MIT C++20 core combines Karplus-Strong strings, dispersion delays, fixed-array Schroeder diffusion, modulation and filter blocks behind a JUCE-free header layer.
top_repos.port_idea: Start with one Karplus-Strong string plus the fixed-array Schroeder diffuser, replace its construction-time vectors with fixed storage, and leave Lua, spectral analysis and JUCE examples out.
top_repos.note: New - The MIT C++20 core combines Karplus-Strong strings, dispersion delays, fixed-array Schroeder diffusion, modulation and filter blocks behind a JUCE-free header layer.
top_repos.summary: AbacDsp is a creative DSP library for audio plugins and standalone applications. Header-only, zero-dependency C++20 building blocks, with Lua scripting designed for LLM-assisted sound design.

top_repos.portability_reason: Reusable DSP is present, but JUCE, VST, Android, or plugin wrappers need separating before firmware use.
top_repos.value_reason: Its native C++ wavetable factory and oscillator are already separated from the Kotlin UI through a narrow Oboe/JNI audio layer.
top_repos.port_idea: Keep the wavetable factory and oscillator, replace Oboe/JNI with the board callback, and cap table count and resolution to the available SRAM.
top_repos.note: Returning - Its native C++ wavetable factory and oscillator are already separated from the Kotlin UI through a narrow Oboe/JNI audio layer.
top_repos.summary: Wavetable Synthesizer is an Android app created as a journey to overcome my own fears of C++. This project combines Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and C++ through the Java Native Interface (JNI) to explore real-time audio processing in a mobile environment.

top_repos.portability_reason: The three resonators and excitation generators have tiny fixed state, but the current synthesizer renders whole utterances into vectors and couples them to text parsing and WAV-file output.
top_repos.value_reason: The MIT single-file C++20 synth turns Japanese phonemes into impulse/noise excitation and a three-resonator Klatt-style formant cascade with focused unit tests.
top_repos.port_idea: Keep the three resonators, noise and impulse generators as a streaming mono voice, replace vector-built utterances with a fixed phoneme queue, and remove command-line and WAV-file output.
top_repos.note: New - The MIT single-file C++20 synth turns Japanese phonemes into impulse/noise excitation and a three-resonator Klatt-style formant cascade with focused unit tests.
top_repos.summary: 437行のC++で日本語を喋る -- A tiny Japanese formant speech synthesizer in ~437 lines of C++

top_repos.portability_reason: A scalar f32 backend and allocation-free process graph exist, but construction owns Vec-backed pools and the Rust core is not documented as no_std, so a fixed subset and arena are required.
top_repos.value_reason: The MIT Rust core combines WDF passive networks with local Newton-Raphson tube, diode, transistor and op-amp models, a WIDTH=1 scalar backend, preallocated signal buffers, oversampling, and ready-made amp stages.
top_repos.port_idea: Start with ScalarFloat and one diode or triode stage plus its tone stack, replace compile-time Vec-owned pools with a fixed board arena, and defer SIMD dispatch and multi-stage oversampling until measured.
top_repos.note: Returning - The MIT Rust core combines WDF passive networks with local Newton-Raphson tube, diode, transistor and op-amp models, a WIDTH=1 scalar backend, preallocated signal buffers, oversampling, and ready-made amp stages.
top_repos.summary: Real-time SIMD-optimized analog circuit simulation for audio DSP

top_repos.portability_reason: The audio path uses caller-owned medium storage and noexcept sample operations, but setup builds vector-backed Langevin/resampler tables and the double-heavy hysteresis solver needs Cortex-M7 profiling.
top_repos.value_reason: The MIT C++17 library models tape as caller-owned media plus Jiles-Atherton hysteresis, bias, wavelength-derived head losses, companding and polyphase scatter/gather resampling.
top_repos.port_idea: Port the caller-owned medium plus one head-loss or hysteresis path, replace the Langevin and resampler vectors with fixed tables, and defer a full multitrack deck until cycles and memory are measured.
top_repos.note: New - The MIT C++17 library models tape as caller-owned media plus Jiles-Atherton hysteresis, bias, wavelength-derived head losses, companding and polyphase scatter/gather resampling.
top_repos.summary: A tape deck as a library: medium, heads, layers, seams, and a polyphase resampler that scatters as well as gathers. JUCE-free, MIT.

top_repos.portability_reason: The reusable header core is separate and process methods avoid allocation, but C++20 features, broad configuration, and optional plugin/convolution modules should be cut from the firmware build.
top_repos.value_reason: The MIT header library separates no-allocation fuzz, tube-preamp, tone-stack, fixed-buffer spring-reverb, and static oversampling blocks from optional plugin and convolution code.
top_repos.port_idea: Start with VintageFuzzDSP or one tube stage, disable oversampling, replace C++20-only conveniences if needed, then size spring delays explicitly before enabling reverb.
top_repos.note: Returning - The MIT header library separates no-allocation fuzz, tube-preamp, tone-stack, fixed-buffer spring-reverb, and static oversampling blocks from optional plugin and convolution code.
top_repos.summary: Biblioteca de DSP para áudio. C++ Audio DSP library for VST/VST3 plugins, Reaper, Audacity, and OBS Studio. Processamento e edição de áudio em tempo real. ENGINE DE PROGRAMAÇÃO VST3 E ÁUDIO.

top_repos.portability_reason: The no_std frame path has tiny fixed state and no allocation, but all coefficients and hot-path processing are f64, which needs an f32 specialization for Cortex-M7 throughput.
top_repos.value_reason: This MIT Rust crate implements Bauer stereo-to-binaural crossfeed with reference-vector tests, streaming state, no_std support and allocation-free frame processing, a useful headphone block absent from stock embedded audio libraries.
top_repos.port_idea: Specialize the coefficient, state and process_frame path to f32 for Cortex-M7, preserve the C-reference golden vectors, and expose the three documented crossfeed profiles as fixed hardware presets.
top_repos.note: Returning - This MIT Rust crate implements Bauer stereo-to-binaural crossfeed with reference-vector tests, streaming state, no_std support and allocation-free frame processing, a useful headphone block absent from stock embedded audio libraries.
top_repos.summary: A modern Rust implementation of the Bauer stereophonic-to-binaural (bs2b) crossfeed DSP
